{"code":"local function clamp(x, lo, hi)
    if x < lo then return lo end
    if x > hi then return hi end
    return x
end

local function resolve_attack(attacker, defender, skill)
    local crit_chance = attacker.crit_chance or 0
    local crit_mult   = attacker.crit_mult or 150
    local pen_pct     = attacker.pen_pct or 0
    local pen_flat    = attacker.pen_flat or 0

    local hp       = defender.hp
    local shield   = defender.shield or 0
    local armor    = defender.armor
    local def_lvl  = defender.level
    local def_elem = defender.element
    local resist   = defender.resist or {}
    local guarding = defender.guarding or false

    local power        = skill.power
    local skill_elem   = skill.element or 'physical'
    local hits_total   = skill.hits or 1
    local true_dmg     = skill.true_damage or false
    local seed         = skill.seed or 0

    local function elem_mult(ae, de)
        if ae == 'physical' then
            if de == 'ghost' then return 0 end
            return 100
        end
        if ae == 'fire' then
            if de == 'fire' then return 50 end
            if de == 'water' then return 50 end
            if de == 'nature' then return 200 end
            return 100
        end
        if ae == 'water' then
            if de == 'fire' then return 200 end
            if de == 'water' then return 50 end
            if de == 'nature' then return 50 end
            return 100
        end
        if ae == 'nature' then
            if de == 'fire' then return 50 end
            if de == 'water' then return 200 end
            if de == 'nature' then return 50 end
            return 100
        end
        return 100
    end

    local absorbed = 0
    local overkill = 0
    local crits    = 0
    local resolved = 0
    local killed   = false

    local k = 1
    while k <= hits_total and hp > 0 do
        resolved = resolved + 1

        -- 1. Base
        local p = math.max(10, power - 20 * (k - 1))
        local d = math.floor(attacker.atk * p / 100)

        -- 2. Level
        local diff = clamp(attacker.level - def_lvl, -10, 10)
        d = math.floor(d * (100 + 3 * diff) / 100)

        -- 3. Critical
        local is_crit = false
        if (seed + 17 * k) % 100 < crit_chance then
            is_crit = true
            d = math.floor(d * crit_mult / 100)
        end

        -- 4. Armor
        if not true_dmg then
            local pen = pen_pct
            if is_crit then
                pen = pen_pct * 2
                if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
            end
            local ea = math.floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
            if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
            d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
        end

        -- 5. Element
        local immune = false
        if not true_dmg then
            local m = elem_mult(skill_elem, def_elem)
            d = math.floor(d * m / 100)
            if m == 0 then immune = true end
            local r = resist[skill_elem] or 0
            r = clamp(r, -50, 80)
            d = math.floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
        end

        -- 6. Guard
        if guarding then
            d = math.floor(d / 2)
        end

        -- 7. Minimum
        if d < 1 then
            if immune then d = 0 else d = 1 end
        end

        -- 8. Shield
        local a = math.min(shield, d)
        shield = shield - a
        local loss = d - a
        if a > 0 and shield == 0 then
            loss = math.floor(loss * 125 / 100)
        end
        absorbed = absorbed + a

        -- 9. HP
        if loss >= hp then
            overkill = loss - hp
            hp = 0
            killed = true
        else
            hp = hp - loss
        end

        if is_crit then crits = crits + 1 end

        k = k + 1
    end

    return {
        damage  = defender.hp - hp,
        absorbed = absorbed,
        hp       = hp,
        shield   = shield,
        overkill = overkill,
        crits    = crits,
        hits     = resolved,
        killed   = killed,
    }
end

local function fmt(r)
    return string.format('{d=%d,a=%d,hp=%d,sh=%d,ov=%d,cr=%d,hi=%d,kl=%s}',
        r.damage, r.absorbed, r.hp, r.shield, r.overkill, r.crits, r.hits, tostring(r.killed))
end

local r1 = resolve_attack(
    {atk=40, level=12, crit_chance=30, crit_mult=150, pen_pct=25, pen_flat=5},
    {hp=60, shield=10, armor=40, level=10, element='nature', resist={fire=20}, guarding=false},
    {power=120, element='fire', hits=2, true_damage=false, seed=3}
)
local r2 = resolve_attack(
    {atk=90, level=3, crit_chance=50, crit_mult=200, pen_pct=40, pen_flat=10},
    {hp=300, shield=25, armor=60, level=20, element='fire', resist={water=-30}, guarding=true},
    {power=100, element='water', hits=3, true_damage=false, seed=40}
)

local res = fmt(r1) .. ' | ' .. fmt(r2)

logic_define('resolve_attack', resolve_attack)

return res"}

  if not coreai_world_exists(name) then return 'none' end
  local towers = {}
  local dmin = math.huge
  for k = 1, 8 do
    local tn = 'Tower' .. k
    if coreai_world_exists(tn) then
      local p = coreai_world_pos(tn)
      if p then
        local cp = coreai_world_pos(name)
        if cp then
          local dx = (p.x - cp.x)
          local dz = (p.z - cp.z)
          local d = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz)
          if d < dmin then dmin = d end
          towers[#towers+1] = {name=tn, d=d}
        end
      end
    end
  end
  if #towers == 0 then return 'none' end
  local thresh = 1.01 * dmin
  for _, t in ipairs(towers) do
    if t.d <= thresh then return t.name end
  end
  return 'none'
end)"}

{"code":"local function route(grid, teleporters)
    local rows = #grid
    local cols = #grid[1]
    local S_r, S_c, G_r, G_c
    for r = 1, rows do
        for c = 1, cols do
            local ch = string.sub(grid[r], c, c)
            if ch == 'S' then
                S_r, S_c = r, c
            elseif ch == 'G' then
                G_r, G_c = r, c
            end
        end
    end

    local INF = 1e9
    local dist = {}
    local function state_idx(r, c, keys)
        return (r - 1) * cols * 4 + (c - 1) * 4 + keys
    end

    local start_keys = 0
    local start_idx = state_idx(S_r, S_c, start_keys)
    dist[start_idx] = { cost = 0, actions = 0 }

    local heap = {}
    table.insert(heap, { r = S_r, c = S_c, keys = start_keys, cost = 0, actions = 0 })

    local best_cost = INF
    local best_actions = INF

    local dirs = { { -1, 0 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0, -1 }, { 0, 1 } } -- up, down, left, right

    while #heap > 0 do
        -- find minimum by (cost, actions)
        local min_i = 1
        for i = 2, #heap do
            if heap[i].cost < heap[min_i].cost or
               (heap[i].cost == heap[min_i].cost and heap[i].actions < heap[min_i].actions) then
                min_i = i
            end
        end
        local cur = table.remove(heap, min_i)
        local cur_idx = state_idx(cur.r, cur.c, cur.keys)
        if cur.cost > dist[cur_idx].cost or
           (cur.cost == dist[cur_idx].cost and cur.actions > dist[cur_idx].actions) then
            goto continue
        end

        -- expand moves
        for _, dir in ipairs(dirs) do
            local dr, dc = dir[1], dir[2]
            local nr, nc = cur.r + dr, cur.c + dc
            if nr >= 1 and nr <= rows and nc >= 1 and nc <= cols then
                local ch = string.sub(grid[nr], nc, nc)
                if ch ~= '#' then
                    -- one-way restrictions
                    if ch == '>' and dc ~= 1 then goto skip_move end
                    if ch == '<' and dc ~= -1 then goto skip_move end
                    if ch == '^' and dr ~= -1 then goto skip_move end
                    if ch == 'v' and dr ~= 1 then goto skip_move end
                    -- door restrictions
                    if ch == 'A' and not (cur.keys == 1 or cur.keys == 3) then goto skip_move end
                    if ch == 'B' and not (cur.keys == 2 or cur.keys == 3) then goto skip_move end

                    local move_cost = (ch == '~') and 3 or 1
                    local new_keys = cur.keys
                    if ch == 'a' then
                        if cur.keys == 0 then new_keys = 1
                        elseif cur.keys == 2 then new_keys = 3 end
                    elseif ch == 'b' then
                        if cur.keys == 0 then new_keys = 2
                        elseif cur.keys == 1 then new_keys = 3 end
                    end
                    local new_cost = cur.cost + move_cost
                    local new_actions = cur.actions + 1

                    if nr == G_r and nc == G_c then
                        if new_cost < best_cost or
                           (new_cost == best_cost and new_actions < best_actions) then
                            best_cost = new_cost
                            best_actions = new_actions
                        end
                    else
                        local new_idx = state_idx(nr, nc, new_keys)
                        if not dist[new_idx] or
                           new_cost < dist[new_idx].cost or
                           (new_cost == dist[new_idx].cost and new_actions < dist[new_idx].actions) then
                            dist[new_idx] = { cost = new_cost, actions = new_actions }
                            table.insert(heap, { r = nr, c = nc, keys = new_keys,
                                                 cost = new_cost, actions = new_actions })
                        end
                    end
                    ::skip_move::
                end
            end
        end

        -- expand teleports
        for _, t in ipairs(teleporters) do
            if t.fr == cur.r and t.fc == cur.c then
                local tr, tc = t.tr, t.tc
                local ch = string.sub(grid[tr], tc, tc)
                if ch == '#' then goto skip_teleport end
                if ch == 'A' and not (cur.keys == 1 or cur.keys == 3) then goto skip_teleport end
                if ch == 'B' and not (cur.keys == 2 or cur.keys == 3) then goto skip_teleport end

                local new_keys = cur.keys
                if ch == 'a' then
                    if cur.keys == 0 then new_keys = 1
                    elseif cur.keys == 2 then new_keys = 3 end
                elseif ch == 'b' then
                    if cur.keys == 0 then new_keys = 2
                    elseif cur.keys == 1 then new_keys = 3 end
                end
                local new_cost = cur.cost + t.cost
                local new_actions = cur.actions + 1

                if tr == G_r and tc == G_c then
                    if new_cost < best_cost or
                       (new_cost == best_cost and new_actions < best_actions) then
                        best_cost = new_cost
                        best_actions = new_actions
                    end
                else
                    local new_idx = state_idx(tr, tc, new_keys)
                    if not dist[new_idx] or
                       new_cost < dist[new_idx].cost or
                       (new_cost == dist[new_idx].cost and new_actions < dist[new_idx].actions) then
                        dist[new_idx] = { cost = new_cost, actions = new_actions }
                        table.insert(heap, { r = tr, c = tc, keys = new_keys,
                                             cost = new_cost, actions = new_actions })
                    end
                end
                ::skip_teleport::
            end
        end
        ::continue::
